# How to Start an LLC

> > A comprehensive guide to forming and understanding Limited Liability Companies, from foundational concepts through state-specific registration steps.

How to Start an LLC provides step-by-step guidance for entrepreneurs starting LLCs, covering formation processes, legal requirements, cost analysis, and service provider comparisons. The site includes state-specific guides, templates, and educational content on LLC structures, taxation, and liability protection.

## Key Topics

- LLC Formation
- Articles of Organization
- Operating Agreement
- EIN (Employer Identification Number)
- Registered Agent
- State Selection
- Business Registration
- Manager-Managed vs Member-Managed
- LLC Naming Requirements
- Formation Services
- Secretary of State
- Business Structure
- Liability Protection
- Tax Advantages
- Formation Costs

## Getting Started with LLCs

- [How to Start an LLC](https://howtostartanllc.com): Homepage: 5-step guide to starting an LLC with state selection to EIN
- [What is an LLC](https://howtostartanllc.com/what-is-an-llc): Foundational guide explaining LLC structure, liability, and taxation
- [7 Benefits of Starting an LLC](https://howtostartanllc.com/7-benefits-of-starting-an-llc): Overview of 7 key LLC benefits including liability and tax advantages

## LLC Formation Process

- [How to Form an LLC](https://howtostartanllc.com/form-an-llc): Step-by-step LLC formation guide from idea stage to registration
- [LLC Business Name Search](https://howtostartanllc.com/llc-name-search): Tool and guide for searching available LLC names and compliance
- [What is an EIN](https://howtostartanllc.com/what-is-an-ein): Guide to EIN: purpose, application process, and business requirements
- [What is a Registered Agent](https://howtostartanllc.com/what-is-a-registered-agent): Guide to registered agents: role, requirements, and selection process

## LLC Structure and Management

- [Free LLC Operating Agreement Template](https://howtostartanllc.com/free-operating-agreement-template): Free downloadable LLC operating agreement template for ownership setup
- [LLC Managers and Members: What's the Difference](https://howtostartanllc.com/form-an-llc/llc-managers-and-members-whats-the-difference): Explanation of LLC management structures: member vs. manager roles
